scripts.build: npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/shared && npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/database && npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/api && npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/worker && npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/shared && npm run dev -w @reliable-job-platform/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/shared && npm run dev -w @reliable-job-platform/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/shared && npm run dev -w @reliable-job-platform/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @reliable-job-platform/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
